checks: Last flush returns without waiting for vblank and retains buffer ownership
Polling before reload neither copies nor releases a pending frame
Refresh callback cannot render over a pending hidden buffer
Reload completion releases exactly one pending frame in the main loop
A 16x16 update synchronizes 1024 bytes instead of the entire 737280-byte buffer
Dirty synchronization uses correct input and output virtual strides
The hidden buffer contains the presented pixels for the next partial frame
Overlapping partial flushes synchronize their union once and increment one frame
Full-screen changes use the smaller packed physical buffer copy
scope: Real ARM scheduling/dirty copies; DMA/LTDC primitives simulated. Hardware timing and GFXMMU mapping are not verified.
